notes: Records 601-764 of PhyBook2 (parsed_items.jsonl lines 4311-4474, item_id suffixes 600-763). THIS COMPLETES PhyBook2.txt, THE PHYSICS SEGMENT AND THE ENTIRE 4,474-RECORD CORPUS. Coverage: introduction to modern physics (Physics 2nd Paper Ch8, suffixes 600-655) split across relativity, the photoelectric effect, X-rays and matter waves; atomic model and nuclear physics (Ch9, 656-724) split across the Bohr model, nuclear structure, radioactivity and fission/fusion; semiconductor and electronics (Ch10, 725-752); and astronomy (Ch11, 753-763). Radioactivity is by far the heaviest block here - roughly sixty records of half-life arithmetic - so it is split by the quantity being solved for (fraction remaining, elapsed time, half-life, activity) rather than by the physical situation, which is identical throughout. Astronomy had no content in the ontology before this batch; it was the last Physics section still showing as empty. No new topics needed: the syllabus taxonomy covered every record. All descriptions are plain text with no backslashes.
